subject: Newbie: knitr-minimal.Rnw produces old fashioned Sweave Output on New R Studio 0.96; Need 'library(knitr)' to compile

messages.author: 746a110d20a6f112
messages.subject: Newbie: knitr-minimal.Rnw produces old fashioned Sweave Output on New R Studio 0.96; Need 'library(knitr)' to compile
parts:
Hi-

I have not used Sweave in a while but was intrigued by knitr and the ease with which R studio integrates them. I am trying to run the knitr-minimal.Rnw file and have two problems:

1) If I run the file 'as is' (copy and paste from the website) and then the brand new version of R-Studio I hit: 'Compile pdf' I get this error message: "Line 21 object 'opts_chunk' not found.

2) I was able to resolve this by inserting "library(knitr) under the <<setup,>> chunk at the begining of the file. However the output resembles the old Sweave output (the ">" prompts are still there, there is no pretty gray box, et cetera,) so I don't think my file is actually being 'knitted'. Also, whenever I press the Compile PDF button, R studio insersts \SweaveOpts{Condordance=TRUE} right after \begin{document}.

I have tried sticking prompt=FALSE into various chunk headers and they still show up. I have also tried running the output .tex file in a different editor (TexMaker) and I still get the same result.

I apologize for the newbie question as I think I'm missing something pretty basic, like running knit() at the end of the file? But I thought I could run the 'mininmal' file as is and get the desired result.

Any help, hints, redirection is appreciated.

I am running R Studio 0.96.122. Here is my sessionInfo:

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.15.0 (2012-03-30)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin9.8.0/x86_64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] C/en_US.UTF-8/C/C/C/C

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tools_2.15.0

Here is a link to my logfile:http://dl.dropbox.com/u/9577903/knitr-minimal.log

Thanks

Frank

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Newbie: knitr-minimal.Rnw produces old fashioned Sweave Output on New R Studio 0.96; Need 'library(knitr)' to compile
parts:
Hi,

This is because you did not set the weaving method to be knitr; the
default is Sweave.

http://rstudio.org/docs/authoring/rnw_weave
http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/rstudio/

Regards,
Yihui
